name: Population
definition: Resident population under the source definition
comparability_notes: Preserve census versus projection methodology and reference date

name: Population growth rate
definition: Change in resident population over the stated interval
comparability_notes: Derive only from definitionally compatible population series

name: Urban population share
definition: Share of population classified as urban
comparability_notes: Urban rural classification can change over time

name: Net migration rate
definition: Net migrants relative to reference population
comparability_notes: Migration interval and residence definition must be retained

name: Life expectancy at birth
definition: Expected years of life at birth under source life table assumptions
comparability_notes: Methodology revisions must be versioned

name: Infant mortality rate
definition: Deaths under age one per one thousand live births
comparability_notes: Direct survey and modeled estimates must not be silently combined

name: Child stunting prevalence
definition: Share of measured children meeting source stunting definition
comparability_notes: Survey design and age universe are material

name: Health facility access
definition: Population or settlements with stated access to a health facility
comparability_notes: Operational access definition must be explicit

name: Mean years of schooling
definition: Average completed years of formal schooling for source age universe
comparability_notes: Age universe and methodology must be stable

name: Expected years of schooling
definition: Expected schooling years for a child under current participation patterns
comparability_notes: Use official methodology metadata

name: Secondary education completion
definition: Share of relevant population completing secondary education
comparability_notes: Education level classifications can change

name: Tertiary education attainment
definition: Share of adult population with tertiary education
comparability_notes: Age universe and credential classification required

name: Labor force participation rate
definition: Share of working age population in labor force
comparability_notes: Working age and survey redesigns must be tracked

name: Open unemployment rate
definition: Unemployed persons as share of labor force
comparability_notes: Definition and survey period must be retained

name: Underemployment rate
definition: Employed persons meeting source underemployment criteria as share of relevant workers
comparability_notes: Hours threshold and desire for additional work can change

name: Formal employment share
definition: Share of employed persons classified as formal under source methodology
comparability_notes: Formal informal classification must be documented

name: Real GRDP per capita
definition: Constant-price gross regional domestic product divided by population
comparability_notes: Base-year chain and population denominator must be explicit

name: Real GRDP growth
definition: Growth of constant-price gross regional domestic product
comparability_notes: Rebasing creates breaks requiring linking decisions

name: Poverty headcount rate
definition: Population below official poverty line as share of population
comparability_notes: Poverty line methodology and survey comparability are material

name: Gini ratio
definition: Income or expenditure inequality measured by official Gini methodology
comparability_notes: Underlying welfare aggregate must be retained

name: Labor productivity
definition: Real output divided by employed persons or hours under stated definition
comparability_notes: Denominator and sector coverage must be explicit

name: Manufacturing share of GRDP
definition: Manufacturing value added as share of current-price GRDP
comparability_notes: Industrial classification and GRDP rebasing matter

name: Agriculture share of GRDP
definition: Agriculture forestry and fisheries value added as share of current-price GRDP
comparability_notes: Sector classification changes must be tracked

name: Rice yield
definition: Harvested rice output per unit harvested area
comparability_notes: Harvested area methodology revisions are material

name: Fisheries production
definition: Production volume under capture and or aquaculture definition
comparability_notes: Capture and aquaculture should remain separable

name: Export value
definition: Value of exports assigned to source geography and period
comparability_notes: Port of loading and origin concepts must not be conflated

name: Road density
definition: Length of road network relative to land area
comparability_notes: Road class and administrative responsibility must be explicit

name: Good-condition road share
definition: Share of road length classified good under source standard
comparability_notes: Condition categories may change

name: Household electricity access
definition: Share of households with electricity under source definition
comparability_notes: Grid and non-grid access should be distinguishable

name: Household internet access
definition: Share of households or persons with internet access under source definition
comparability_notes: Device and recall period definitions can change

name: Travel time to major market
definition: Modeled or observed travel time from settlement or regional centroid to defined major market
comparability_notes: Network vintage mode and destination definition required

name: Own-source regional revenue
definition: Realized locally generated revenue under official budget classification
comparability_notes: Budget classification and nominal versus real treatment required

name: Regional government expenditure per capita
definition: Realized regional expenditure divided by population
comparability_notes: Functional classification and denominator required

name: Capital expenditure share
definition: Capital expenditure as share of realized regional expenditure
comparability_notes: Budget classification revisions must be tracked

name: Fiscal independence ratio
definition: Own-source revenue relative to total regional revenue under stated formula
comparability_notes: Formula variants must be named rather than mixed

name: Annual rainfall
definition: Accumulated precipitation over stated annual reference period
comparability_notes: Station completeness and interpolation method required

name: Extreme rainfall days
definition: Count of days exceeding a documented precipitation threshold
comparability_notes: Threshold and missing-day treatment required

name: Mean temperature
definition: Mean near-surface air temperature over stated period
comparability_notes: Station moves instrumentation and aggregation matter

name: Forest cover share
definition: Share of land area classified as forest under source land-cover taxonomy
comparability_notes: Classification scheme and imagery vintage required

name: Recorded flood events
definition: Count of officially recorded flood events under source event definition
comparability_notes: Reporting intensity and event deduplication must be assessed

name: Recorded landslide events
definition: Count of officially recorded landslide events under source event definition
comparability_notes: Reporting intensity and event deduplication must be assessed

name: Disaster-affected population
definition: People reported affected by disaster events under source definition
comparability_notes: Affected displaced injured and exposed populations are distinct

name: Reported direct disaster loss
definition: Direct loss value reported for disaster events under source accounting
comparability_notes: Nominal price year coverage and missing loss estimates required

name: Mean elevation
definition: Area-weighted mean elevation derived from reference DEM
comparability_notes: DEM product and zonal aggregation method required

name: Steep-slope land share
definition: Share of area above a documented slope threshold
comparability_notes: DEM resolution and threshold required

name: Network distance to Padang
definition: Shortest network distance from defined origin to Padang reference destination
comparability_notes: Origin destination and network vintage required

name: Historical population
definition: Population reported for historical source-era geography
comparability_notes: Must remain attached to source-era geography unless explicitly harmonized

name: Historical literacy rate
definition: Share literate under source-era definition and population universe
comparability_notes: Definition language age universe and extraction confidence required

name: Historical school enrollment
definition: Enrollment count or rate under source-era education system
comparability_notes: Education system and grade mappings require explicit crosswalks

name: Historical transport access
definition: Documented transport infrastructure or accessibility measure for source-era geography
comparability_notes: May require mixed quantitative and qualitative evidence
